create_albert_masked_lm: create an ALBERT model for masked language modeling to predict masked tokens in text
create_albert_sequence_classification: create an ALBERT model for sequence classification with a linear classifier head on pooled output
create_albert_question_answering: create an ALBERT model for question answering that predicts start and end positions of answers
create_albert_token_classification: create an ALBERT model for token classification such as NER with a per-token classifier head
create_albert_pretraining: create an ALBERT model with masked language modeling and sentence order prediction heads for pretraining
